title: Teasing Master Takagi-san
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Middle schooler Takagi teases her seatmate Nishikata with harmless pranks and embarrassing questions, partly because she has a crush on him. Nishikata keeps scheming to get even and keeps losing, slowly realizing his own feelings. The chapters are short, episodic school days.
life_message: It holds up playful friendship, patience and the slow growth of honest affection.

content.note: Pranks only (Common Sense Media, anime; Wikipedia).
